[P1] 小顽童科绘馆
幸福的恐龙
【认识恐龙】
好朋友童书 编绘
化学工业出版社
·北京·

[P2] 故事开始

[P3] 在远古的森林里，一只慈母龙正伤心地哭着。
原来，她的蛋宝宝们不知道被谁偷走了。
知道更多
慈母龙生活在白垩纪，过着群居生活，以
树叶、浆果和植物的种子为食。慈母龙妈妈每
次产蛋18～40颗，蛋的形状像个柚子。慈母
龙成年后体长约9米，体重约4吨。

[P4] “骨碌碌……”
突然，一个圆圆的东西
滚到了慈母龙妈妈的脚边。
啊哈！是一颗蛋！

失去蛋宝宝的慈母龙十分珍惜这个天赐的宝宝，每天都把它抱在怀里。几天后，蛋里钻出了一只可爱的小恐龙，
慈母龙妈妈给他取了个好听的名字——贝贝。

[P5] 慈母龙妈妈非常疼爱贝贝，总是给他吃最甜美的浆果和最鲜嫩的树叶。
月亮出来的时候，还会给他讲故事、唱童谣。
贝贝也很爱很爱妈妈。

[P6] 日子一天天地过去，贝贝也慢慢长大了。
可他却常常听到小伙伴们在议论他的长相。
“头那么小，个子又矮。”
“一点儿也不像他妈妈！”
贝贝委屈地钻进了妈妈怀里，问：“妈妈，为什么我长得和你不一样？”
“因为你还小，长大了就会变得像妈妈了。”妈妈安慰他说。
“那我要快快长大！”贝贝开心地说。

[P7] 一天，贝贝在森林里捉蝴蝶，突然发现树上贴着一张“寻人启事”，上面的宝宝和自己长得很像。
贝贝很害怕，转身就跑，他想马上回到妈妈身边。他边哭边跑，一不小心却迷路了。

[P8] 贝贝只顾着哭，并没有留意脚下的路。突然，他被一块大石头绊倒了，骨碌碌地滚进了海里。幸好蛇颈龙看见了，他伸长脖子把贝贝救了起来。
“谢谢你救了我。请问你见过我的妈妈吗？”
“孩子，我一直忙着抓鱼，没见过你妈妈。你去前面找找吧！”蛇颈龙晃了晃身子又潜入海里。
知道更多
蛇颈龙生活在三叠纪到白垩纪晚期，以鱼类为食，是海洋、湖泊中的霸主。分为长颈蛇颈龙和短颈蛇颈龙。
长颈蛇颈龙的脖子长、嘴巴大、尾巴短，身体像海龟，能在海中游泳，也能爬到岸上。短颈蛇颈龙则脖子较短、嘴部长、头部大，身体强壮，鳍脚大而有力，适于游泳。
蛇颈龙虽然也叫“龙”，但它们并不属于恐龙。

[P9] 贝贝沿着海边走了好久好久，可一直没看到妈妈。
他越走越害怕，肚子也饿得咕咕叫。
贝贝好想妈妈。

[P10] 贝贝走啊走，遇到了正在吃草的三角龙父子。
“请问你们见过我妈妈吗？”贝贝急忙问道。
三角龙爸爸点点头，说道：“孩子，刚刚有一群
窃蛋龙从这里经过，你快追上去吧！”

[P11] “窃蛋龙是谁，是偷蛋的小偷吗？”贝贝吃惊地问道。
“你是一只窃蛋龙，你妈妈当然也是窃蛋龙啊！”三角龙爸爸微笑着说。
“不，我妈妈是慈母龙，我才不是小偷的孩子呢！”贝贝气得噘起了嘴。

知道更多
三角龙是一种植食性恐龙，生活在白垩纪晚期，它们有非常大的头盾，脑袋上有三只尖角。成年的三角龙体长约9米，高约3米。三角龙通常成群聚集在一起，遇到危险时，成年三角龙会围成一圈保护幼龙。

[P12] “窃蛋龙是谁，是偷蛋的小偷吗？”贝贝吃惊地问道。
“你是一只窃蛋龙，你妈妈当然也是窃蛋龙啊！”三角龙爸爸微笑着说。
“不，我妈妈是慈母龙，我才不是小偷的孩子呢！”贝贝气得噘起了嘴。
知道更多
三角龙是一种植食性恐龙，生活在白垩纪晚期，它们有非常大的头盾，脑袋上有三只尖角。成年的三角龙体长约9米，高约3米。三角龙通常成群聚集在一起，遇到危险时，成年三角龙会围成一圈保护幼龙。

[P13] 突然，远处传来了可怕的吼叫声。
“快跑！霸王龙来了！”三角龙爸爸带着小三角龙飞快地跑开了。
贝贝吓得浑身发抖，只能呆呆地愣在原地大哭。
知道更多
霸王龙是凶猛的肉食性恐龙，生活在白垩纪晚期，是较晚灭绝的恐龙。成年霸王龙体长约13米，高约5米，后肢强壮有力，奔跑速度很快，每小时可达17千米。而且它嗅觉灵敏，有锋利的牙齿。

[P14] 忽然，贝贝感觉自己飞了起来。
睁开眼一看，
原来是风神翼龙
救了自己。

“谢谢你！请问你知道我妈妈在哪儿吗？”
“当然知道，我飞得又高又快，我带你去找
她吧！”风神翼龙得意地扇动着巨大的翅膀说。
贝贝开心极了。

知道更多
风神翼龙是一种翼手龙，生活在白垩纪晚期。风
神翼龙的翼展超过11米，它有着长长的脖子和腿，擅
长飞翔，也可以在陆地上行走。它是人类已知的最大的飞行动物。
翼龙的名字虽然也有个“龙”字，但它也不属于
恐龙。

[P15] 风神翼龙带着贝贝，飞过了树林、
河流、高山，最终停在一座山上。

“孩子，你到家了，快去找你妈妈吧！
“不，这里不是我的家。”贝贝转过头想要解释，可是风神翼龙已经飞走了。

[P16] 突然，一群窃蛋龙把贝贝围了起来。
其中一只窃蛋龙一把将贝贝抱进了怀里。
看着这只和自己长得一模一样的窃蛋龙，贝贝胆怯而疑惑地叫了一声：‘妈妈？’
‘是的，我的孩子，你终于回来了。’
窃蛋龙妈妈流着眼泪，将贝贝搂得更紧了。
知道更多
窃蛋龙生活在白垩纪晚期，是最像鸟类的恐龙之一。窃蛋龙体长约3米，头短，有长长的尾巴，行动敏捷，善于奔跑。
考古学家第一次发现这种恐龙化石时，误会它保护自己产的恐龙蛋的动作是在偷蛋，因此将其命名为‘窃蛋龙’，但其实它们并不是小偷。

[P17] 后来，贝贝和窃蛋龙妈妈一起找到了慈母龙妈妈。
现在，贝贝有两个妈妈啦，它们都非常非常爱他。贝贝也爱两个妈妈。
贝贝觉得，自己是世界上最最幸福的恐龙。
full_text_en:
[P1] Little Naughty Children's Science and Art Gallery
Happy Dinosaurs
[Getting to Know Dinosaurs]
Compiled and Illustrated by Good Friends Children's Books
Chemical Industry Press
·Beijing·

[P2] The story begins

[P3] In an ancient forest, a mother dinosaur was crying sadly.
It turned out her baby eggs had been stolen by someone.
Learn More
Maiasaura lived in the Cretaceous period, lived in groups, and fed on leaves, fruits, and plant seeds. A mother Maiasaura laid 18 to 40 eggs each time, and the eggs were shaped like pomelos. An adult Maiasaura was about 9 meters long and weighed about 4 tons.

[P4] "Rumble..."
Suddenly, a round object
rolled to the mother Maiasaura's feet.
Ah! It's an egg!

The Maiasaura, having lost her egg baby, cherished this gift from heaven dearly, holding it close every day. A few days later, a cute little dinosaur hatched from the egg,
and the mother Maiasaura gave him a lovely name—Bei Bei.

[P5] The mother Maiasaura loved Beibei very much, always feeding him the sweetest berries and the freshest leaves.
When the moon came out, she would tell him stories and sing lullabies.
Beibei loved his mother very much too.

[P6] Days passed, and Bebe slowly grew up.
But he often heard his friends talking about his appearance.
"His head is so small, and he's so short."
"He doesn't look like his mom at all!"
Bebe sadly nestled into his mom's arms and asked, "Mom, why don't I look like you?"
"Because you're still little. When you grow up, you'll look like me," his mom comforted him.
"Then I'll grow up quickly!" Bebe said happily.

[P7] One day, Beibei was catching butterflies in the forest when he suddenly noticed a 'Missing Child' poster on a tree. The baby on the poster looked very much like him.
Beibei was scared and turned to run. He wanted to get back to his mom right away. He ran while crying, and accidentally got lost.

[P8] Bebi was crying and didn't pay attention to the path under his feet. Suddenly, he tripped over a big rock and tumbled into the sea. Luckily, a plesiosaur saw him and stretched his neck to rescue Bebi.
"Thank you for saving me. Have you seen my mom?"
"Child, I've been busy catching fish. I haven't seen your mom. Go look ahead!" The plesiosaur wiggled his body and dived back into the sea.
Know More
Plesiosaurs lived from the Triassic to the late Cretaceous period, fed on fish, and were the rulers of oceans and lakes. They are divided into long-necked and short-necked plesiosaurs.
Long-necked plesiosaurs have long necks, large mouths, short tails, and bodies like turtles. They can swim in the sea and also climb onto land. Short-necked plesiosaurs have shorter necks, long snouts, large heads, strong bodies, and large, powerful flippers, suitable for swimming.
Although plesiosaurs are also called 'dragons', they do not belong to dinosaurs.

[P9] Beibei walked along the seaside for a long, long time, but never saw his mom.
He got more and more scared, and his stomach growled with hunger.
Beibei missed his mom so much.

[P10] Bebe walked and walked, and met a Triceratops father and son grazing.
"Have you seen my mom?" Bebe asked anxiously.
The Triceratops father nodded and said, "Child, a group of Oviraptors just passed by here. You should chase after them!"

[P11] "Who are the oviraptors, and are they egg thieves?" Bebe asked in surprise.
"You are an oviraptor, so your mother must be one too!" the Triceratops father said with a smile.
"No, my mother is a Maiasaura, I'm not the child of a thief!" Bebe pouted angrily.

Learn More
Triceratops were herbivorous dinosaurs that lived in the late Cretaceous period. They had large frills and three horns on their heads. Adult Triceratops were about 9 meters long and 3 meters tall. They usually gathered in groups, and when danger appeared, adult Triceratops would form a circle to protect their young.

[P12] "Who are the oviraptors, egg-thieves?" Bebe asked in surprise.
"You are an oviraptor, so your mom must be one too!" the Triceratops dad said with a smile.
"No, my mom is a Maiasaura, I'm not the child of a thief!" Bebe pouted angrily.
Know More
Triceratops were herbivorous dinosaurs that lived in the Late Cretaceous period. They had large frills and three horns on their heads. Adult Triceratops were about 9 meters long and 3 meters tall. They usually gathered in groups, and when in danger, adult Triceratops would form a circle to protect their young.

[P13] Suddenly, a terrifying roar came from afar.
"Run! The Tyrannosaurus is coming!" The Triceratops father and his baby Triceratops ran away quickly.
Bei Bei was so scared that he trembled all over, and could only stand frozen in place, crying loudly.
Learn More
The Tyrannosaurus was a fierce carnivorous dinosaur that lived in the late Cretaceous period and was one of the last dinosaurs to go extinct. Adult Tyrannosaurus were about 13 meters long and 5 meters tall, with strong hind legs, running at speeds up to 17 kilometers per hour. It also had a keen sense of smell and sharp teeth.

[P14] Suddenly, BeiBei felt himself flying.
He opened his eyes and saw
that it was a Quetzalcoatlus
who had saved him.

"Thank you! Do you know where my mom is?"
"Of course I do! I fly high and fast. I'll take you to find her!" the Quetzalcoatlus said proudly, flapping its huge wings.
BeiBei was overjoyed.

Learn More
The Quetzalcoatlus is a type of pterosaur that lived in the late Cretaceous period. The Quetzalcoatlus had a wingspan over 11 meters, with a long neck and legs, skilled in flying, and could also walk on land. It is the largest flying animal known to humans.
Although the name 'pterosaur' contains the character 'dragon', it is not a dinosaur.

[P15] The Pteranodon carried Bebe, flying over forests, rivers, and mountains, finally stopping on a hill.

"Child, you've arrived home, go find your mom quickly!"
"No, this isn't my home," Bebe turned around to explain, but the Pteranodon had already flown away.

[P16] Suddenly, a group of oviraptors surrounded Beibei.
One of the oviraptors grabbed Beibei and held him close.
Looking at this oviraptor who looked exactly like himself, Beibei called out timidly and uncertainly: "Mom?"
"Yes, my child, you've finally come back."
The oviraptor mother, tears streaming down her face, held Beibei even tighter.
Learn More
Oviraptors lived in the Late Cretaceous period and were among the dinosaurs most similar to birds. Oviraptors were about 3 meters long, had short heads, long tails, were agile, and good at running.
When paleontologists first discovered fossils of this dinosaur, they misunderstood its action of protecting its own dinosaur eggs as stealing eggs, hence naming it 'Oviraptor', but in fact, they were not thieves.

[P17] Later, Beibei and the oviraptor mother found the mother of the mother dinosaur together.
Now, Beibei has two mothers, and they both love him very much. Beibei also loves his two mothers.
Beibei feels that he is the happiest dinosaur in the world.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《幸福的恐龙》的封面，展示了书名、系列名称、编绘者和出版社信息，并配有一只卡通恐龙的插图。
[P2] 本页显示‘故事开始’字样，配有一只从蛋壳中破壳而出的小恐龙插图，标志着绘本故事的正式开启。
[P3] 在远古森林中，一只慈母龙因蛋宝宝被偷走而伤心哭泣，页面还附有关于慈母龙生活习性和特征的科普知识。
[P4] 一只慈母龙妈妈在森林中发现了一颗滚到脚边的蛋，她将其视为天赐的宝宝并细心照料，几天后蛋中孵化出一只小恐龙，她为它取名为贝贝。
[P5] 慈母龙妈妈悉心照料小恐龙贝贝，给他最好的食物，夜晚为他讲故事和唱童谣，贝贝也深爱着妈妈。
[P6] 贝贝在成长过程中因长相与妈妈不同而被同伴议论，感到委屈，妈妈安慰他长大后就会像自己，贝贝因此决定要快快长大。
[P7] 贝贝在森林里捉蝴蝶时，发现一张与自己长相相似的寻人启事，因害怕而逃跑，结果在慌乱中迷了路。
[P8] 贝贝在慌乱中滚入海里，被蛇颈龙救起，他向蛇颈龙询问妈妈的下落，但蛇颈龙表示未见过，建议他继续寻找。页面还附有蛇颈龙的科普知识。
[P9] 贝贝沿着海边寻找妈妈，走了很久却始终没有找到，他感到害怕和饥饿，非常想念妈妈。
[P10] 贝贝在森林里寻找妈妈时，遇到了正在吃草的三角龙父子，他向他们询问妈妈的下落，三角龙爸爸告诉他有一群窃蛋龙刚经过，建议他追上去。
[P11] 贝贝向三角龙父子询问窃蛋龙的情况，因被误认为是窃蛋龙而感到委屈，同时页面附有三角龙的科普知识。
[P12] 贝贝向三角龙父子询问窃蛋龙的情况，被误认为是窃蛋龙而感到委屈，同时页面附有三角龙的科普知识。
[P13] 贝贝在森林里寻找妈妈时，突然听到霸王龙的吼叫声，三角龙父子惊慌逃走，贝贝因害怕而呆立原地大哭。页面还附有霸王龙的科普知识。
[P14] 贝贝在森林中被风神翼龙救起，他向风神翼龙询问妈妈的下落，风神翼龙答应带他去找，贝贝因此感到非常开心。页面还附有风神翼龙的科普知识。
[P15] 风神翼龙带着贝贝飞过树林、河流和高山，最终停在一座山上，告诉贝贝到家了，让他去找妈妈，但贝贝表示这里不是他的家，风神翼龙却已飞走。
[P16] 贝贝被一群窃蛋龙围住，其中一只窃蛋龙妈妈认出他并紧紧抱住，贝贝误以为找到了妈妈，画面下方附有窃蛋龙的科普知识。
[P17] 贝贝和窃蛋龙妈妈一起找到了慈母龙妈妈，从此他有了两个妈妈，感到非常幸福。
